components.name: mobilenet_v3_small_v1
components.task: Binary flood detection from street imagery
components.evaluation_status: FLAWED (100% reported test acc due to duplicate leakage and non-road class bias)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Historical artifact only. Contaminated by train-test duplicate leakage and non-road imagery.
components.known_domain_limitations: Severe duplicate leakage; memorized arbitrary background pixels.

components.name: mobilenet_v3_small_v2
components.task: Binary flood detection from street imagery
components.training_dataset: Manifest V2 (Clean split of roham1 dataset, 2,246 images)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Collapses to 53.15% accuracy on Test V3. 94.0% False Positive Rate on unseen plain dry roads (misclassifies 47/50 dry roads as flood). Test ECE = 0.4526.
components.known_domain_limitations: Learned thumbnail resolution artifact (non-floods were 224x224 thumbnails; floods were >800px). Cannot recognize dry asphalt.

components.name: mobilenet_v3_small_v3_clean
components.task: Binary flood detection from street imagery
components.training_dataset: Manifest V3 (Clemson floods vs Virenbr11 plain/potholes, 1,478 images)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: 97.30% accuracy, 97.30% macro-F1 on Test V3. 98.36% accuracy on wet potholes hard negatives. Under synthetic rain mist blur, accuracy drops to 93.24% (FNR 13.51%).
components.known_domain_limitations: Source-label confounding (Clemson vs Virenbr11). Degrades under heavy precipitation.

components.name: mobilenet_v3_small_v3_monsoon
components.task: Binary flood detection under harsh monsoon weather conditions
components.output_semantics: Calibrated probability [0, 1] of flooding with 0.65 ambiguity abstention
components.training_dataset: Manifest V3 with synthetic monsoon augmentations (rain streaks, glare, water spray)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: 97.75% accuracy on Test V3. 100% specificity on plain dry roads (0/50 false positives). 98.36% accuracy on wet potholes hard negatives (1/61 false positives). 96.85% accuracy on synthetic rain mist blur. Calibration ECE = 0.0237.
components.known_domain_limitations: Source-label confounding remains in underlying data (Cramer's V = 1.0). Requires shadow evaluation with human supervision.

components.name: metadata_shortcut_classifier_rf
components.task: Diagnostic quantification of non-semantic dataset confounding
components.input_features: width, height, aspect_ratio, file_size_kb, megapixels, bytes_per_pixel
components.output_semantics: Binary probability of class from image file metadata alone
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Achieves 85.97% test accuracy and 0.9066 ROC-AUC on Test V4 without observing image pixels.
components.known_domain_limitations: Not a flood detector; diagnostic proof of camera sensor / file size confounding.

components.name: image_quality_gate
components.task: Pre-inference filtering of degraded or uninformative imagery
components.output_semantics: Boolean pass/fail with explicit degradation reason (BLURRY, UNDEREXPOSED, OVEREXPOSED, LOW_RESOLUTION)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: 100% rejection of severely blurred (Laplacian < 80), night pitch black (mean < 35), whiteout glare (mean > 230), and low resolution (< 640x480) inputs.
components.known_domain_limitations: Rejects valid scenes if camera lens is heavily obscured.

components.name: rainfall_risk_engine
components.task: Deterministic rainfall intensity and multi-window accumulation risk assessment
components.input_features: rain_1h_mm, rain_3h_mm, rain_6h_mm, rain_24h_mm, station_dist_km, data_freshness_hours
components.output_semantics: Categorical risk (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL, UNKNOWN), score [0, 1], confidence [0.10, 1.0]
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Verified across IMD boundaries (7.5, 15.0, 35.0, 100.0 mm/hr), monotonicity, multi-window surge/saturation, and confidence penalties. Missing rain strictly produces UNKNOWN (conf=0.10).
components.known_domain_limitations: Subject to rain gauge distance and latency; convective cloudbursts under 2km wide may escape regional gauges.

components.name: road_vulnerability_engine
components.task: Multi-criteria spatial vulnerability index for urban corridors
components.output_semantics: Vulnerability index [0.0, 1.0] and tier (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, SEVERE)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Monotonicity verified across proximity subscores. Correctly identifies Tolichowki as HIGH (0.532) and Miyapur as MODERATE (0.435).
components.known_domain_limitations: Represents static physical susceptibility, NOT active inundation. A SEVERE road is completely safe during dry weather.

components.name: corridor_susceptibility_analysis
components.task: Spatial characterization of 20 candidate Hyderabad road corridors
components.input_features: Corridor geographic coordinates, KML drain lines, KML hotspots, GeoJSON waterbodies
components.output_semantics: Summary statistics of proximities across central/western municipal corridors
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Mean distance to hotspot: 2,263.7m; mean distance to drain: 533.3m; mean distance to waterbody: 983.6m.
components.known_domain_limitations: Exploratory statistics only; must not be claimed as verified flood prediction.

components.name: telemetry_continuity_diagnostics
components.task: Data quality and continuity profiling of Telangana rain gauge telemetry
components.output_semantics: Missingness percentages, accumulator counts, transmission gap lengths
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: Quantified 50.82% bucket accumulator records (>250mm), 19 negative sensor glitches, and up to 141.6-day transmission gaps.

components.name: vision_v4_production_deep_model
components.input_features: RGB road imagery from multiple independent sources
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: N/A. Production training blocked due to Cramer's V = 1.0000 and 0 real field observations.
components.known_domain_limitations: Cannot be trained reliably on current data without learning non-semantic camera shortcuts.

components.name: supervised_flood_occurrence_prediction
components.task: Predictive model for road flood occurrence from rainfall and vulnerability features
components.input_features: rain_1h_mm, rolling rainfall, static vulnerability features
components.training_dataset: N/A (Zero ground-truth flood outcome observations exist)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: N/A. Static KML hotspots lack timestamps, dates, and depths. 0 real observations in database.
components.known_domain_limitations: Requires at least 50 verified flood episodes and 100 non-flood episodes across >=4 storm dates.

components.name: short_term_hourly_rainfall_forecasting
components.task: Temporal precipitation forecasting for 1-hour and 3-hour horizons
components.training_dataset: N/A (Telemetry exhibits >90% temporal missingness and accumulator confusion)
components.valid_evaluation_evidence: N/A. Gaps up to 141.6 days; 50.82% bucket accumulator counters; 0 stations in GHMC core.
components.known_domain_limitations: Requires dedicated continuous urban AWS telemetry with >=98% uptime.
